BiblicalUsage: Bedad means "solitary." He was the father of an Edomite chief. It turns up in Genesis 36:35 and 1 Chronicles 1:46.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bedad is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
